tagline.en: Boston's outer belt, thirty miles out and 121 miles long
tagline.zh: 波士顿外环：离城三十英里，全长 121 英里

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-95 at Salisbury, on the New Hampshire line
start.zh: 索尔兹伯里，新罕布什尔州界附近，与 I-95 相接

end.zh: 韦勒姆，与 I-195 及 25 号州道相接

en: I-495 is the outer of Boston's two beltways — Route 128, closer in, is the other — and at 120.8 miles it is the second-longest auxiliary Interstate in the country, about eleven miles shorter than I-476 in Pennsylvania. It runs as an arc of roughly thirty miles' radius from the centre of Boston, from Salisbury near the New Hampshire line round through Lawrence, Lowell, Marlborough and Taunton to Wareham at the head of Cape Cod.

The even hundreds digit is accurate: both ends are on I-95. On the way round it crosses seven radial expressways — I-93, US 3, Route 2, I-290, the Massachusetts Turnpike, Route 24 and I-95 again — which is what makes it useful, since a driver can reach almost any part of eastern Massachusetts from it without going near the city. It also functions as a rough boundary line in local usage: land inside it is metropolitan Boston, land outside it generally is not.
zh: I-495 是波士顿两条环线中偏外的那条——更靠内的是 128 号州道——全长 120.8 英里，是全美第二长的辅助州际公路，比宾夕法尼亚州的 I-476 短约十一英里。它以距波士顿市中心约三十英里为半径画出一道弧，自新罕布什尔州界附近的索尔兹伯里起，经劳伦斯、洛厄尔、马尔伯勒与汤顿，一路绕到科德角入口处的韦勒姆。
偶数百位是准确的：两端都接在 I-95 上。绕行途中它横穿七条放射状快速路——I-93、US 3、2 号州道、I-290、马萨诸塞收费公路、24 号州道，以及再一次的 I-95——这正是它好用的原因：司机不必靠近市区，就能从这条路抵达马萨诸塞州东部几乎任何地方。在当地语汇里，它还是一条粗略的边界：环内算大波士顿，环外一般就不算了。

en: An outer circumferential highway about thirty miles out from Boston was already being planned in the late 1940s. Because the proposed loop met the relocated US 1 — the future I-95 — at both ends, Massachusetts submitted it to the federal Bureau of Public Roads for inclusion in the Interstate system; approval guaranteed ninety per cent federal funding towards an estimated $125 million, with the state paying the rest. The I-495 designation was assigned in 1958.

The last piece to be built was in the south-east. The 14.3-mile, six-lane link from Route 24 in Raynham to I-95 at the Foxborough–Mansfield town line started at the I-95 end in 1976 and opened in November 1982, completing the belt. On the same occasion the older four-lane expressway south of Raynham, built in stages between 1959 and 1967 and signed until then as Route 25, was renumbered as part of I-495. The effect on the region was immediate: the regional planning district recorded an eighteen per cent rise in traffic on I-495 between 1982 and 1983, and industrial parks that had sat empty for years began to fill.
zh: 早在 1940 年代末，一条距波士顿约三十英里的外围环状公路就已在规划中。由于拟建环线两端都接上改线后的 US 1（即后来的 I-95），马萨诸塞州将其上报联邦公共道路局，请求纳入州际公路系统；获批意味着估算的 1.25 亿美元造价中有九成由联邦承担，余额由州政府支付。I-495 的编号于 1958 年确定。

最后建成的一段在东南部。自雷纳姆的 24 号州道至福克斯伯勒－曼斯菲尔德镇界 I-95 的这段 14.3 英里六车道连接线，1976 年从 I-95 一端开工，1982 年 11 月通车，环线由此建成。同时，雷纳姆以南那条 1959 至 1967 年分期建成、此前一直挂 25 号州道的四车道快速路，也改编为 I-495 的一部分。对该区域的影响立竿见影：区域规划机构记录到 I-495 的交通量在 1982 至 1983 年间上升了 18%，多年空置的工业园区开始有企业入驻。

timeline.en: The outer circumferential highway is assigned the number I-495.
timeline.zh: 这条外围环状公路获得 I-495 编号。

timeline.en: The first section of what is now southern I-495 opens as Route 25 in Middleborough.
timeline.zh: 今日 I-495 南段的首段以 25 号州道形式在米德尔伯勒通车。

timeline.en: Work begins at I-95 on the last 14.3 miles.
timeline.zh: 最后 14.3 英里工程在 I-95 一端开工。

timeline.en: The belt is completed in November and the Route 25 section is renumbered I-495.
